sceneLabel: Line drawing of a power station generating unit: a cut-open 660 megawatt turbo-generator on its foundation table, three bus ducts, a step-up transformer, a 400 kilovolt bay of arresters, current transformers, circuit breakers and disconnectors, the gantry where the line leaves and a synchronising desk; the rotor spins and the breaker and disconnector open and close in turn; on hover the modules move apart
